evidence_states.name: synthetic_or_modelled_surface_confirmed
evidence_states.required_state: a real deployed workflow or publicly available product surface using a synthetic or modelled population
evidence_states.refused_inference: a synthetic surface does not establish replacement, validation, performative effect, preference change, or public authorization

evidence_states.name: parallel_direct_human_infrastructure_confirmed
evidence_states.required_state: a named direct-human research surface exists alongside the synthetic surface within the same institutional or product environment
evidence_states.refused_inference: parallel human infrastructure does not establish that the methods touch the same decision or validate one another

evidence_states.name: integrated_synthetic_to_human_validation_architecture_confirmed
evidence_states.required_state: the product or workflow publicly specifies a route from synthetic exploration to configurable direct-human validation
evidence_states.refused_inference: available validation architecture does not establish that a particular output was validated or that every output must be validated

evidence_states.name: executed_matched_study_with_complete_receipts
evidence_states.required_state: one executed paired study preserves matched instruments, populations, response distributions, uncertainty, discrepancy handling, decision disposition, and version lineage
evidence_states.refused_inference: product capability, complement language, or provider methodology claims do not establish a complete executed matched study

evidence_states.name: human_evidence_can_bind_the_operational_decision
evidence_states.required_state: an attributed rule permits direct-human evidence to amend, suspend, override, or block the synthetic recommendation and the consequence is receipted
evidence_states.refused_inference: human consultation or validation does not establish operational override authority

evidence_states.name: affected_public_has_binding_objective_control_and_remedy
evidence_states.required_state: the affected public can bind the objective, agenda, decision rule, implementation, challenge, appeal, and remedy
evidence_states.refused_inference: survey participation, customer research, human validation, or operational override does not confer public sovereignty

required_next_evidence: one complete executed matched synthetic-human study
attributed human override rule and consequence
human-to-model feedback reuse and version update
deployment-specific runtime metric policy and validation lineage
affected-public correction withdrawal complaint and remedy route
binding objective-control authority or explicit absence state
prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the topology as a product ranking, market share, prevalence estimate, or quality score.
Do not infer matched validation from parallel human infrastructure.
Do not infer executed validation from an available hybrid architecture.
Do not infer human override from validation or consultation.
Do not infer public authorization from human evidence or operational override.
Do not infer causal effect, preference change, manipulation, legitimacy, or intent from an unresolved topology state.
Do not create graph, thesis, actor-profile, allegation, or publication authority from this comparative control surface.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A bounded comparative topology joining three real-world packets across synthetic deployment, parallel human infrastructure, and integrated human-validation architecture.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A product ranking, market denominator, complete matched-study finding, public-authority verdict, causal conclusion, or evidence against a named actor.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: The current real-case estate publicly reaches integrated synthetic-to-human validation architecture. It does not yet contain one fully receipted executed matched study, an attributed operational human-override consequence, or binding affected-public objective control.
